items.title: Why Stryker (SYK) Shares Are Plunging Today
items.summary: Shares of medical technology company Stryker (NYSE:SYK) fell 7.3% in the morning session after the company reported second-quarter results that showed revenue that only met Wall Street's expectations and organic sales growth that missed forecasts.
